facts: Same 250-cycle WAT command; title requires OS USB bus devices.

original_test_intent.statement: Perform 250 DC reboots while verifying required OS-visible USB topology returns after every boot.
must_preserve: 250 cycles, DC reboot and USB device/bus validation.
unknowns: Private scenario mapping, physical USB port/device baseline and allowed transient hubs.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It fails to expose that the shown command contains no obvious usbPoll selector.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Obtain WAT proof of usbPoll behavior and a port-path/serial baseline before 250 disruptive cycles.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run 250 WAT DC Reboots with OS USB Polling
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify every required physical USB path and attached test device re-enumerates correctly after each of 250 DC reboot cycles.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Pinned WAT/OS USB stack with stable physical port mapping and OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Declared USB controllers, hubs, physical port paths and device VID:PID/serial; exactly 250 cycles.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Exact WAT package version/hash/provenance, signed flag-to-usbPoll and output/side-effect semantics, exact command and protected secret path, approved DC controller/off-on-dwell method, explicit cycle-success/count/failure/retry rule, controller-BDF-to-physical-hub/port/sysfs baseline, required/optional VID:PID/serial matrix, boot/enumeration timeouts, data/workload isolation, external evidence storage, recovery and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: After proof, run a bounded 250-cycle state machine. For each numbered attempt, execute the approved DC waveform, prove the power and boot transition, wait for signed OS-ready/enumeration timeouts, collect the complete controller-BDF-anchored physical/sysfs topology and device identities, compare every required/optional entry, capture errors externally, and advance the completed-cycle counter only under the signed success rule. Stop at the first failed attempt; no automatic retry.
revision_candidate.preconditions: All required test devices are physically secured, workloads/data are in the approved power-loss-safe state, external evidence survives DC removal, OOB/power recovery works and no user hot-plug occurs.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Exact WAT artifact/hash, command and usbPoll semantics; DC controller/waveform; immutable attempt/completion ledger; per-attempt power/boot times; controller BDF, hub and physical/sysfs path; expected and observed VID:PID/serial for every device; optional-device disposition; enumeration timing; WAT output; USB reset/disconnect errors; BMC/OS logs; failed-attempt/retry authorization and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Exactly 250 qualifying cycles under the signed count rule; every required physical path/device returns within timeout after every cycle with correct BDF-anchored topology and identity, and no disallowed USB/boot/platform error. Failed attempts remain visible and cannot be replaced unless the owner-approved rule explicitly permits and dispositions them.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No unproven scenario, count-only lsusb evidence, hidden retry, log clearing or port substitution.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: USB/platform owner approves topology and disruptive run.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical device placement is manual; verified harness collection is automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Abort, preserve the missing-path and power state in external evidence, recover via OOB, inspect cabling/power, and perform any diagnostic retry only after fresh approval under the signed count policy.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unmapped usbPoll or artifact semantics, ambiguous/unsafe DC waveform, incomplete BDF-anchored mapping, missing/wrong device/path, unauthorized extra/hot-plug, boot/enumeration timeout, USB reset storm, harness/output/evidence/OOB failure, power anomaly or unclear cycle accounting.

identified_defects: WAT syntax does not visibly identify usbPoll.
reason_for_change: USB device counts can stay equal while the wrong port or replacement device appears; V3 binds each cycle to physical topology and serial identity.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 detects the ambiguous shared WAT invocation and requires per-port, per-device identity rather than a generic USB presence check.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validator found insufficient private-artifact proof, deterministic cycle/retry accounting and DC power/data/evidence safeguards. Revalidation confirmed exact artifact semantics, BDF-anchored USB mapping, 250-cycle accounting, no automatic retry and external evidence safety.
